notes: A cleaner look: square cards and boxes, lightly rounded buttons, a coloured bar on each row (red while money is due or stock is low) and tidier menus. The printed bill now carries its note, a purchase's lot number, and the cash given with the change returned. Expiry is typed as MM/YYYY; an expired lot cannot be received, and Expiring Soon is worked out from the lots in stock. Mobile numbers are exactly 10 digits. Home shows how Cash + Bank Balance is counted and how much of today's sale is still due. History has three filter buttons and a clearer collection card. The shop card comes in 8 designs and 12 colours. The daybook sheet has full details, and there is a new customers and suppliers sheet. Turning the phone no longer brings the PIN lock back. A shop set to wholesale only is no longer offered the retail rate.
